reason: Every wait, release and hold reads the account clock (block.timestamp plus demo skips) by design (PRD 7 rule 6, S03-8). Comparisons are against 48-hour, 7-day and weekly boundaries, far above any block-time drift.
The loops run over at most 3 live schedule records and 4 envelopes (S03-10, S03-51); storage writes inside them are bounded and needed.
The literals are the PRD's own fixed values: the merchant category codes of the default shop table (R9), 100 for percent, 5 envelopes, 4 weekly shares and 7 days a week. Naming each adds nothing.
The loops are bounded at 5 split values and 3 schedule records; reverting on the first bad value is the intended check (R4).
